patterns.title: Repeated tool calls with identical arguments
patterns.diagnosis: The agent repeatedly called the same tool with the same arguments inside the selected window.
patterns.likelyCause: The prompt may not make prior tool observations sticky enough, or the agent may be re-checking instead of acting on already-read evidence.
patterns.suggestedFix: Add guidance to summarize consumed tool results before retrying, and only repeat identical reads when new time has elapsed or an earlier call failed.

patterns.title: Missing information was encountered repeatedly
patterns.diagnosis: The trace shows repeated unavailable, missing, or failed information while the agent continued the turn sequence.
patterns.likelyCause: The prompt may not specify how to recover from incomplete evidence or when to ask a guard/operator for clarification.
patterns.suggestedFix: Add fallback rules for missing evidence: state uncertainty, ask one targeted question, or escalate only when the missing fact is operationally critical.

patterns.title: Information repeatedly rewritten in workspace
patterns.diagnosis: The agent wrote to the same workspace file multiple times in the selected window.
patterns.likelyCause: The agent may be adding and revising notes instead of maintaining a stable summary of decisions and evidence.
patterns.suggestedFix: Prompt the agent to append durable findings and avoid rewriting the same fact unless it explicitly marks the update as superseding prior analysis.
